title: Locally connected Siegel Julia sets
exact_target: Find a provably locally connected Siegel quadratic Julia set, decide whether this happens for almost every rotation angle, and determine what can be said about its Hausdorff dimension.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300034 (AMR-052-0034). CC BY 4.0.
John Milnor, ``Problems on local connectivity'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), Problem 9, pp. 22; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
